task_text: Complete Vizora homepage redesign from light Electric Horizon to Little Worlds + Studio visual direction. Full rebuild of information architecture, copy, hero, 3D scene (café/hotel/retail dioramas), and conversion narrative. Preserve semantic HTML, real routes, geo-pricing, accessibility.
files_to_read_first: schema.prisma (roles: admin/manager/viewer; players: four platform types)
verdict: Marketing UI redesign extends existing Electric Horizon codebase. No agent/MCP involvement. Hermes-first check: [1] pricing API `/api/geo-pricing` already exists (consume as-is), [2-5] all other steps are net-new UI/UX work (components, 3D assets, CSS, copy). Drift-check: read auth.service.ts + sla/page.tsx to verify trial/SLA claims before including in copy. Decision: prerendered 3D assets (Blender) + CSS composition for best fidelity-to-effort ratio on solo development.
